scenario: A bank's dispute resolution team reviews a batch of credit-card chargeback cases. A transaction categorizer classifies each disputed transaction by type and merchant liability basis, a financial calculator computes the net chargeback amount and interchange fee recovery owed to the cardholder, and a reporting skill produces a formal adjudication memo that documents the decision and payable amount.
info_flow: categorize-transactions classifies each disputed card transaction into a dispute type and annotates merchant liability basis -> financial-calculator uses the category annotation to compute the chargeback award (transaction amount adjusted for any applicable fees) -> reporting assembles the adjudication memo with the decision and final payable amount for each case.
